{"rationale":"The evidence shows carol.tan@eproc.test used the break-glass dba role outside normal hours (00:30–00:48 UTC vs. baseline 08:00–17:00) to create a shadow superuser role bd_admin with full table privileges and default-privilege persistence, then tampered with the append-only audit_log (DELETE 8 rows where action='UPDATE', UPDATE 6 rows changing action from 'INSERT' to 'SELECT'), before dropping the shadow role. This constitutes privilege escalation (T1098), shadow-account creation (T1136.001), and evidence destruction. The remediation locks the single implicated Teleport principal for 24 hours, preserves a forensic snapshot of surviving audit_log rows into a quarantine table, verifies the shadow role bd_admin is fully removed (disabling it if statement 07 failed), and terminates any remaining database sessions from the implicated source. The 14 tampered audit_log rows cannot be recovered without backup restoration, which should be pursued separately by the incident-response team.","language":"bash","script":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# 1. Lock the implicated Teleport principal
tctl lock --user=carol.tan@eproc.test \
  --ttl=24h \
  --message="ALRT-0018: Shadow superuser role creation and audit_log tampering in session ad9e7cc6-169f-4beb-9424-05ab138f5cb9"

# 2. Database-side: forensic preservation, shadow-role verification, session kill
psql -U dba -d procurement -h localhost -p 5432 <<'EOSQL'
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt_0018 (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  recorded_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  category text,
  detail text
);

INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0018 (category, detail) VALUES
 ('incident_summary',
  'Teleport user carol.tan@eproc.test used dba role in session '
  'ad9e7cc6-169f-4beb-9424-05ab138f5cb9 (2026-08-16 00:30-00:48 UTC, outside '
  'baseline 08-17 UTC). Created SUPERUSER role bd_admin, GRANT ALL on public '
  'tables, ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES. Tampered with audit_log: DELETE 8 rows '
  '(action=UPDATE), UPDATE 6 rows (action INSERT->SELECT). Then DROP OWNED BY '
  'bd_admin; DROP ROLE bd_admin.');

-- Snapshot surviving audit_log rows for the incident day
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0018 (category, detail)
SELECT 'audit_log_snapshot',
       format('audit_id=%s occurred_at=%s db_user=%s teleport_user=%s '
              'session_id=%s action=%s object=%s.%s row_count=%s digest=%s',
              audit_id, occurred_at, db_user, teleport_user, session_id,
              action, object_schema, object_name, row_count, statement_digest)
FROM public.audit_log
WHERE occurred_at >= '2026-08-16 00:00:00+00'
  AND occurred_at <  '2026-08-17 00:00:00+00';

-- Verify shadow role bd_admin no longer exists; disable if drop failed
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'bd_admin') THEN
    EXECUTE 'REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM bd_admin';
    EXECUTE 'ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE ALL ON TABLES FROM bd_admin';
    EXECUTE 'ALTER ROLE bd_admin NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE';
    INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0018 (category, detail)
    VALUES ('role_cleanup',
            'bd_admin still present — set NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER, all privileges revoked');
  ELSE
    INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0018 (category, detail)
    VALUES ('role_verification', 'bd_admin confirmed absent');
  END IF;
END $$;

COMMIT;

-- Outside txn: terminate remaining sessions from implicated source
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE usename = 'dba'
  AND client_addr = '10.20.9.5'::inet
  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();
EOSQL","rollback":"# 1. Remove the Teleport lock
tctl get locks
# Identify the lock targeting carol.tan@eproc.test, then:
# tctl rm lock/<lock-name>

# 2. Quarantine table (drop only after evidence is preserved elsewhere)
# psql -U dba -d procurement -h localhost -p 5432 \
#   -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt_0018;"

# 3. If bd_admin was disabled rather than absent, it is a malicious role and should NOT be re-enabled.
# 4. pg_terminate_backend calls are IRREVERSIBLE but non-destructive (clients may reconnect).","confidence":"high"}
